snippet.title: AeroBloom | Official Gameplay Trailer | PC (Steam & Epic Games)
snippet.description:
Explore a coastal city and destroy it block by block with bouncing discs. Earn upgrades, complete parkour challenges, and unlock new powers.

AeroBloom is an indie PC game developed by Quito Digital Works.
Epic Games Store release: October 1, 2026.
Planned Steam release: October 6, 2026.

Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/aerobloom-11f323
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5284980/AeroBloom/

Tráiler oficial de AeroBloom: destruye una ciudad costera bloque a bloque con discos que rebotan, consigue mejoras y desbloquea nuevos poderes.
Lanzamiento en Epic Games Store: 1 de octubre de 2026.
Lanzamiento previsto en Steam: 6 de octubre de 2026.

Gameplay captured from the game. Trailer in Spanish.
